column1: # AIO Feeder hub — 16 MB flash. App sits at 0x10000 so the web-flash layout
# M8a (v0.11.0): otadata + two OTA slots arrive — a fresh flash boots factory
# (otadata empty); an update stages into ota_0/ota_1 and the bootloader's
# rollback (sdkconfig.defaults) reverts to the last valid slot if the new
# image never confirms. The 256 KB "badapp" data partition is a CI/QEMU
# convenience: the OTA selftest streams it through esp_ota_ops as a
# deliberately non-confirming image (tools/qemu/badapp). The rest of the
# 16 MB stays reserved for LVGL assets.
